summary: This fiction excerpt, Book 10 part 80, shows a televised debate on a studio set. Ms. McCavity argues that autonomous networks should advise people on everyday matters but never decide whom the FBI investigates, which should stay with judges, grand juries and evidence. The ewok host Wickett asks the audience to weigh both sides, and afterward a grateful guest thanks McCavity for a law that let him have surgery, while she has Damian on the ropes.
one_line: A televised debate in which Ms. McCavity argues that autonomous networks must not replace judges and grand juries in FBI investigations.
key_facts: Ms. McCavity argues that autonomous networks are acceptable for applications such as advising on the best way to get to the mall on a busy Saturday.
Ms. McCavity says autonomous networks should not decide whom the FBI should open an investigation into.
Ms. McCavity says that judges, grand juries and evidence establish the sufficiency of a request to investigate a private citizen who is considered innocent until proven guilty.
Ms. McCavity states that the country learned the lesson of judges and grand juries the hard way during the War on Terrorism and the Ashcroft witch-hunts.
Ms. McCavity asks whether the warrant for a wiretap should be issued by an accountable human being or by a simulated ant-hill.
Ms. McCavity quotes Franklin: 'Those willing to give up a little liberty for a little security deserve neither security nor liberty.'
Ms. McCavity says no nation on earth has the reliance on these networks that the United States has.
The ewok host Wickett asks how much privacy people should be willing to trade for security, and says both sides make a compelling case.
The ewok has self-identified as an ewok since age five but Lucasfilm would not license the surgery.
The ewok says it could only find a doctor willing to perform the surgery without permission after a law was enacted.
Ms. McCavity responds that the law was not hers but that she helped, and says she is glad it helped.
Damian is the debate opponent, and Ms. McCavity has had him on the ropes since the opening remarks.
The ewok keeps interrupting Damian to let Ms. McCavity rebut.
The ewok has moved to a pbs and has been grooming its fur more conservatively and trying out waistcoats and short pants.
